messages:
maria: Heads-up — the Python quickstart example for tool/function calling with structured output is out of sync with the SDK. The docs use `response_format=...` but the current client expects `schema=` and it actually returns raw JSON string instead of a parsed dataclass, causing JSONDecodeError when you assume parsed objects.

sam: Can you paste a minimal repro and the sdk version?

maria: Using redwood-sdk==0.3.4 on Python 3.11. Minimal repro: 

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="x")
resp = client.tool_call("summarize", input="long text", response_format=MySchema)
print(resp.title)
```

This throws on `print(resp.title)` with: 

```
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```

lee: I hit something similar but with the async client — `await async_client.tool_call(...)` returns a raw `str` (the JSON payload) instead of the Pydantic model. Typing stubs claim it returns `MySchema`. :weary:

jordan: Two separate bugs: 1) docs parameter mismatch (`response_format` vs `schema`) and 2) runtime parsing not applied. Workaround: `parsed = MySchema.parse_raw(resp)` or `json.loads(resp)` and then construct the model. Not great for onboarding.

maria: Proposed fixes: update quickstart to use the correct param name, and add safe auto-parsing in the client when `schema`/pydantic model is passed (maybe a flag `parse_schema=True`). Also flagging retry behavior: when a tool handler 500s, the SDK appears to retry and sometimes returns an older cached response — this is a consistency hazard for tool outputs.

sam: Can you file a GH issue with repro + stack? Tag @devex.

maria: Filed GH #482 with reproducer, stack trace, and suggested doc change: https://github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/issues/482. Assigning followups: async handling to @lee.

lee: I'll pick up the async side. Quick note on typing: our stubs currently say `def tool_call(...) -> T`, but behaviour is `T | str` (raw fallback). I'll open a small typing PR to make it `Union[T, str]` and update the async stub similarly (`async def tool_call(...) -> Union[T, str]`). Also will add an `# type: ignore` example to the quickstart until parsing is stable.

jordan: Also worth adding an `async` example that shows `async with RedwoodClient.as_async(api_key=...)` — many users trip over event loop usage.

maria: Another onboarding friction: the sample apps assume a config file at `~/.redwood/config` and KeyError if it doesn't exist. Can we fallback to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var and document it prominently? New users kept pasting the quickstart and hitting immediate crashes.

sam: Good catch. I'll add that to the docs checklist and include an explicit `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` snippet in quickstart. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — runbook updated.

maria: Action items from thread: docs PR (doc-673) to fix param names + onboarding env var, async typing fix (fix-674) by @lee, and infra check for server-side retry/cache behaviour (infra-675). Ping me if you need the repro files or want me to open the docs PR as well. Thanks!
